david_writing_psalm.prompt: an aged king with a grey beard writing on an open scroll by a clay oil lamp, a harp resting against the stone wall beside him, night chamber, warm lamplight, vertical, ancient Israel

bowed_head_finished.prompt: a view straight down the length of the one wooden crossbeam of the cross, nearest the camera the open hand of the crucified Christ nailed flat to the beam by a single square-headed iron nail through the palm, blood on the wood, his arm lying along the beam leading back to his bowed head crowned with thorns, eyes closed, deep darkness behind, close, vertical, 1st-century Judea

psalm_scroll_night.prompt: an open scroll of faded illegible script beside a burning clay oil lamp on a rough table at night, warm lamplight, close, vertical, ancient Judea

carpenter_bench_rest.prompt: a carpenter's wooden workbench with a finished three-legged wooden stool standing on it, tools laid down neatly, wood shavings, warm evening light through a small window, quiet stone workshop, vertical, 1st-century Judea

child_waking_dawn.prompt: a child stirring awake on a mat as warm dawn light pours through a small window, eyes just opening, hopeful morning interior, vertical, ancient Judea

look_up_faces.prompt: three different upturned 1st-century faces close together in half-light, eyes lifted toward a warm light above, tears catching the light, hope breaking on the faces, vertical

vinegar_sponge_reed.prompt: the thorn-crowned Christ crucified high on a tall cross, both arms stretched out and fixed to the crossbeam, under deep midday darkness; below a Roman soldier stretches up a long slender reed tipped with a small hyssop-bound sponge toward Christ's mouth; side view from a low angle showing the full height of the cross, vertical, 1st-century Judea

face_on_cross.prompt: a close portrait of the crucified Christ from the shoulders up, his thorn-crowned head lifted, eyes open toward heaven, the rough wooden beam behind his head, dim failing light, close, vertical, 1st-century Judea

cross_at_dawn.prompt: an empty wooden cross standing on a rocky hilltop against a golden sunrise, warm light flooding the sky, wide, vertical, 1st-century Judea

father_lamp_doorway.prompt: a robed father holding a small clay oil lamp in the doorway of a stone house at night, warm light spilling across the threshold, seen from inside the dark room, vertical, 1st-century Judea

risen_mercy_hand.prompt: inked biblical graphic-novel of the risen Christ facing forward, one open hand held out low bearing the faint flat healed mark, warm golden light
